comments.author: Chronic
comments.body: PEA and WMB on the same ship? This combo doesnt work together. PEA will disable your own WMB. Your ship needs a defuse or dismantle but its not worth it. Better off just grading and using as a material ship at this point. Stop trying to sell it as if its a good ship taking advantage of newer players that dont know about the PEA/WMB fail combo.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: A junk build, eh? I'll buy it for 500m, bob. Always wanted something for my aide captain to look cool in. (I'm perfectly serious, by the way. IGN's the same as my ivyro one, though I really don't expect to hear from you.)

comments.author: Chronic
comments.body: I didnt say its a "junk build".. Its an average build, I like the creativity in thinking to use the PEA in theory. But the way WMB/PEA work or dont work together makes it a failed build. I just dont want a newer player thinkin the combo works and gets ripped off.

comments.author: HyunA
comments.body:
It is not effective as PEA will definitely trigger opponent's WMB rendering your own WMB useless.

That said, PEA/WMB still works if you face a ship without WMB, such as a 3 skill FCV.

comments.author: flopblob
comments.body: Could be said the other way, because if both ships have PEA it'd cancel them both out.
